53686-melmoth-the-wanderer-vol-2.title: Melmoth The Wanderer Vol 2
53686-melmoth-the-wanderer-vol-2.creator: Unknown
53686-melmoth-the-wanderer-vol-2.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Am I confessing the strength or the weakness of my heart? In the midst of all the systematic dissimulation that I was prepared and eager to carry on, the only circumstance that gave me real compunction, was my being obliged to destroy the letters of that dear and generous youth who had risked every thing for my emancipation.

arxiv-1909-02576.title: Deep Visual Template-Free Form Parsing
arxiv-1909-02576.creator: Brian Davis, Bryan Morse, Scott Cohen, Brian Price, Chris Tensmeyer
arxiv-1909-02576.description: Abstract Automatic, template-free extraction of information from form images is challenging due to the variety of form layouts. This is even more challenging for historical forms due to noise and degradation. A crucial part of the extraction process is associating input text with pre-printed labels.

arxiv-2012-06451.title: Efficacy of the Radial Pair Potential Approximation for Molecular Dynamics Simulations of Dense Plasmas
arxiv-2012-06451.creator: Lucas J. Stanek, Raymond C. Clay III, M.W.C. Dharma-wardana, Mitchell A. Wood, Kristian R.C. Beckwith, Michael S. Murillo
arxiv-2012-06451.description: Abstract Macroscopic simulations of dense plasmas rely on detailed microscopic information that can be computationally expensive and is difficult to verify experimentally. In this work, we delineate the accuracy boundary between microscale simulation methods by comparing Kohn-Sham density functional theory molecular dynamics (KS-MD) and radial pair potential molecular dynamics (RPP-MD) for a range of elements, temperature, and density.

arxiv-2106-01258.title: Assessing the Reliability of Deep Learning Classifiers Through Robustness Evaluation and Operational Profiles
arxiv-2106-01258.creator: Xingyu Zhao, Wei Huang, Alec Banks, Victoria Cox, David Flynn, Sven Schewe, Xiaowei Huang
arxiv-2106-01258.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Xingyu Zhao, Wei Huang, Alec Banks, Victoria Cox, David Flynn, Sven Schewe, Xiaowei Huang. The utilisation of Deep Learning (DL) is advancing into increasingly more sophisticated applications. While it shows great potential to provide transformational capabilities, DL also raises new challenges regarding its reliability in critical functions. In this paper, we present a model-agnostic reliability assessment method for DL classifiers, based on evidence from robustness evaluation and the operational profile (OP) of a given application.

arxiv-2108-07311.title: On the dimension of exceptional parameters for nonlinear projections, and the discretized Elekes-Rónyai theorem
arxiv-2108-07311.creator: Orit E. Raz, Joshua Zahl
arxiv-2108-07311.description: Abstract We consider four related problems. (1) Obtaining dimension estimates for the set of exceptional vantage points for the pinned Falconer distance problem. (2) Nonlinear projection theorems, in the spirit of Kaufman, Bourgain, and Shmerkin. (3) The parallelizability of planar d d -webs. (4) The Elekes-Rónyai theorem on expanding polynomials.

arxiv-2204-00087.title: A quantum learning approach based on Hidden Markov Models for failure scenarios generation
arxiv-2204-00087.creator: Ahmed ZAIOU, Younès BENNANI, Basarab MATEI, Mohamed HIBTI
arxiv-2204-00087.description: Abstract Finding the failure scenarios of a system is a very complex problem in the field of Probabilistic Safety Assessment (PSA). In order to solve this problem we will use the Hidden Quantum Markov Models (HQMMs) to create a generative model.

arxiv-2204-01211.title: p T p_{T} dispersion of inclusive jets in high-energy nuclear collisions
arxiv-2204-01211.creator: Shi-Yong Chen, Jun Yan, Wei Dai, Ben-Wei Zhang, Enke Wang
arxiv-2204-01211.description: Abstract In this study, we investigate the impact of jet quenching on the p T p_{T} dispersion( p T ​ D p_{T}D ) of inclusive jets ( R = 0.2 R=0.2 ) in central Pb+Pb (0-10%) collisions at s = 2.76 \sqrt{s}=2.76 TeV.

arxiv-2305-01710.title: From Stars to Insights: Exploration and Implementation of Unified Sentiment Analysis with Distant Supervision
arxiv-2305-01710.creator: Wenchang Li, John P. Lalor, Yixing Chen, Vamsi K. Kanuri
arxiv-2305-01710.description: Abstract Sentiment analysis is integral to understanding the voice of the customer and informing businesses’ strategic decisions. Conventional sentiment analysis involves three separate tasks: aspect-category detection (ACD), aspect-category sentiment analysis (ACSA), and rating prediction (RP). However, independently tackling these tasks can overlook their interdependencies and often requires expensive, fine-grained annotations.

arxiv-2405-13808.title: Hybrid Quantum-Classical Normalizing Flow
arxiv-2405-13808.creator: Anlei Zhang 1, Wei Cui 2
arxiv-2405-13808.description: Abstract With the rapid development of quantum computing technology, we have entered the era of noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) computers. Therefore, designing quantum algorithms that adapt to the hardware conditions of current NISQ devices and can preliminarily solve some practical problems has become the focus of researchers.

arxiv-2408-05998.title: Matrix Concentration: Order versus Anti-order
arxiv-2408-05998.creator: Reihaneh Malekian, Aaditya Ramdas
arxiv-2408-05998.description: Abstract The matrix Markov inequality by Ahlswede and Winter, 2002 was stated using the Loewner anti-order between positive definite matrices. Wang and Ramdas, 2024 use this to derive several other Chebyshev and Chernoff-type inequalities (Hoeffding, Bernstein, empirical Bernstein) in the Loewner anti-order, including self-normalized matrix martingale inequalities.

arxiv-2411-11232.title: SAMOS: A Neural MOS Prediction Model Leveraging Semantic Representations and Acoustic Features
arxiv-2411-11232.description: Abstract Assessing the naturalness of speech using mean opinion score (MOS) prediction models has positive implications for the automatic evaluation of speech synthesis systems. Early MOS prediction models took the raw waveform or amplitude spectrum of speech as input, whereas more advanced methods employed self-supervised-learning (SSL) based models to extract semantic representations from speech for MOS prediction.

arxiv-2501-06447.title: Flux-Driven Circular Current in a Non-Hermitian Dimerized Aharonov-Bohm Ring: Impact of Physical Gain and Loss
arxiv-2501-06447.creator: Souvik Roy, Santanu K. Maiti
arxiv-2501-06447.description: Abstract In the present theoretical work, we numerically explore magnetic response of a tight-binding dimerized ring subjected to Aharonov-Bohm (AB) flux and environmental interactions. Specifically, we introduce an imaginary site potential on the odd lattice sites to represent physical gain and loss, while the even lattice sites remain unperturbed.

arxiv-2505-17081.title: Lieb-Mattis ordering theorem of electronic energy levels in the thermodynamic limit
arxiv-2505-17081.creator: Manuel Calixto, Alberto Mayorgas, Julio Guerrero
arxiv-2505-17081.description: Abstract Abstract Lieb-Mattis theorem orders the lowest-energy states of total spin s s of a system of P P interacting fermions. We generalize these predictions to fermionic mixtures of P P particles with more than N = 2 N=2 spinor components/species in the thermodynamic limit P → ∞ P\to\infty .

arxiv-2505-18084.title: The Noether formalism for constructing conserved quantities in teleparallel equivalents of general relativity
arxiv-2505-18084.creator: E. D. Emtsova, A. N. Petrov, A.V.Toporensky
arxiv-2505-18084.description: Abstract This paper brings a methodological character where we present a comprehensive formalism for constructing conserved quantities in the Teleparallel Equivalent of General Relativity (TEGR) and Symmetric Teleparallel Equivalent of General Relativity (STEGR). It was developed in series of our earlier works and, here, we unite it into a complete form.

arxiv-2509-05059.title: Dispersion relations of deeply virtual Compton scattering: investigating twist-4 kinematic power corrections
arxiv-2509-05059.creator: Víctor Martínez-Fernández, Cédric Mezrag
arxiv-2509-05059.description: Abstract In this paper we include kinematic power corrections up to twist‑four to the deeply virtual Compton scattering dispersion relation. We demonstrate that, both for (pseudo‑)scalar and spin‑ 1 / 2 1/2 targets, the formal expression of the n n ‑subtracted leading‑twist dispersion relations is preserved. However, the expression of the subtracted constants is modified by the kinematic powers.

arxiv-2510-10204.title: Appell Functions for General Lattices
arxiv-2510-10204.creator: Aradhita Chattopadhyaya a , Jan Manschot b,c
arxiv-2510-10204.description: Abstract We study Appell functions associated to an arbitrary positive definite lattice Λ \Lambda and a choice of M ≤ dim ⁡ ( Λ ) M\leq{\rm dim}(\Lambda) linearly independent vectors d r ∈ Λ d_{r}\in\Lambda , r = 1 , … , M r=1,\dots,M .

pmc-10603433.title: Academy for Quality and Safety Improvement (AQSI) project to improve diagnosis and documentation of malnutrition in a community hospital
pmc-10603433.creator: Om Parkash, Saad Jamil, Valarie Chudzinski, Nayha Tahir, Shrey Gole, Jacqueline Deleon, Cindy Forde, Farah Zahra
pmc-10603433.description: BackgroundMalnutrition is a significant public health problem that affects many patients in inpatient settings. Timely identification and addressing malnutrition in an inpatient setting presents an opportunity to improve patient care and reduce costs. There is a clear link between malnutrition, increased length of hospital stay, higher risk of readmissions and infections, skin breakdown, and higher hospital costs due to complications.

pmc-11547330.title: Selective PPARδ Agonist GW501516 Protects Against LPS-Induced Macrophage Inflammation and Acute Liver Failure in Mice via Suppressing Inflammatory Mediators
pmc-11547330.creator: Hyun-Joung Lim, Hyun Jeong Kwak, George Grant
pmc-11547330.description: Inflammation is critical in the development of acute liver failure (ALF). Peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor delta (PPARδ) regulates anti-inflammatory responses and is protective in several diseases such as obesity and cancer. However, the beneficial effects and underlying mechanisms of PPARδ agonist GW501516 in ALF remain unclear.

pmc-11608352.title: A global patent dataset of bioeconomy-related inventions
pmc-11608352.creator: Lukas Kriesch, Sebastian Losacker
pmc-11608352.description: Many governments worldwide have proposed transitioning from a fossil-based economy to a bioeconomy to address climate change, resource depletion, and other environmental concerns. The bioeconomy utilizes renewable biological resources across all sectors and is strongly founded on scientific advances and technological progress.

pmc-12526538.title: A Sensor Based Waste Rock Detection Method in Copper Mining Under Low Light Environment
pmc-12526538.creator: Jianing Ding, Fuming Qu, Weihua Zhou, Jiajun Xu, Lingyu Zhao, Yaming Ji
pmc-12526538.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). During production, copper mining could generate substantial waste rock that impacts land use and the environment. Advances in deep learning have enabled efficient, cost-effective intelligent sorting, where vision sensor performance critically determines sorting accuracy and efficiency. However, the sorting environment of copper mine waste rock is inherently complex, particularly within the conveyor belt section of the sorting machine, where insufficient and uneven lighting significantly impairs the performance of vision-based detection systems.

pmc-13131395.title: Artificial Intelligence-Assisted CMR Scanning vs Standard-of-Care
pmc-13131395.creator: Raymond Y. Kwong, Benedikt Bernhard, Michael Jerosch-Herold, Leslie K. Lee, Jon Hainer, Tuan Luu, Isabela Reis Marques, Marianna Daibes, Bob Hu
pmc-13131395.description: BackgroundClinical adoption of cardiovascular magnetic resonance (CMR) is hampered by procedural complexity and magnetic resonance imaging access.ObjectivesThe objective of the study was to investigate the benefits of artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted CMR in clinical practice.MethodsPatients at a tertiary-care center underwent CMR via conventional, operator-directed (ODS) or AI-assisted (AIA) scanning over 3 years.

pmc-13136509.title: Predicting Prostate Cancer Risk and Its Associated Factors Using Machine Learning Techniques: A Retrospective Study
pmc-13136509.creator: Serveh Mohammadi, Behzad Imani, Soheila Saeedi, Mohammad Ali Amirzargar
pmc-13136509.description: Background and AimsProstate cancer affects many people around the world and is fatal. Today, artificial intelligence‐based techniques are widely used to predict and diagnose diseases. This study aimed to use machine learning‐based techniques to predict and identify the most significant risk factors of prostate cancer.

pmc-13378512.title: PhSO2CF2H as a difluoromethylene bridge connecting electrophiles and electronically diverse alkenes
pmc-13378512.creator: Yunlong Zhao, Kaidi Zhu, Feng Zhao, Yanxia Zhang, Chuanfa Ni, Jinbo Hu
pmc-13378512.description: The difluoromethylene (–CF2–) motif is highly valuable in pharmaceuticals, agrochemicals, and materials science due to its unique physicochemical properties. Herein, we present a broadly applicable strategy for the modular synthesis of CF2-containing compounds by using difluoromethylene to bridge electrophiles and electronically diverse alkenes, with difluoromethyl phenyl sulfone (PhSO2CF2H) as the difluoromethylene source.

pmc-13531122.title: Plexiform Fibrohistiocytic Tumor: An Updated Review
pmc-13531122.creator: JUN NISHIO, KAORI KOGA, MIKIKO AOKI
pmc-13531122.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Plexiform fibrohistiocytic tumor (PFHT) is a rare locally aggressive and rarely metastasizing mesenchymal neoplasm that most commonly arises in the upper extremities of children and young adults. It typically presents as a small, slow-growing, painless, dermal or subcutaneous mass. Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) often reveals a plaque-like or infiltrative lesion with intermediate signal intensity on T1-weighted sequences and high signal intensity on T2-weighted sequences. Contrast-enhanced MRI demonstrates moderate or avid enhancement.

pmc-13580359.title: Barriers for general practitioners in post-stroke follow-up within a fragmented healthcare system in Sweden – a focus group study
pmc-13580359.creator: Maria Wolf, Maria Flink, Axel C. Carlsson, Mia von Euler, Jan Hasselström
pmc-13580359.description: BackgroundSecondary medical prevention after stroke is effective and well evidenced, making long-term follow-up crucial. This follow-up is mainly made by general practitioners (GPs) in Sweden. Low target achievement and up to fourfold practice variation in dispensation of secondary preventive drugs between different primary care units in Region Stockholm has been described.

pmc-13583448.title: Mesenchymal Stem Cell‐Derived Extracellular Vesicles Ameliorate NaIO3‐Induced Dry AMD by Delivering miR‐486‐3p to Inhibit Lipocalin‐2‐Mediated Ferroptosis
pmc-13583448.creator: Zheng Li, Tujing Zhao, Lin Ye, Runze Li, Huaping Tian, Ruilin Liao, Lulin Huang
pmc-13583448.description: Dry age‐related macular degeneration (AMD), affecting over 196 million people globally, represents the leading cause of irreversible blindness with limited disease‐modifying therapies. The disease is characterized by progressive retinal pigment epithelium (RPE) degeneration driven by ferroptosis, an iron‐dependent form of regulated cell death.

pmc-13617941.title: Ferumoxytol triggers cancer ferroptosis via an NF-κB-driven IRONKILL mechanism
pmc-13617941.creator: Tao Luo, Meng Li, Shijie Zhang, Kang Ding, Feng Gu, Qinguo Huang
pmc-13617941.description: er therapy. Ferroptosis is driven by an abnormal accumulation of intracellular iron ions, which catalyze the buildup of lipid peroxides and ultimately disrupt cellular integrity3. This mechanism challenges conventional paradigms and offers a new strategy to combat refractory tumors that are resistant to apoptosis and prone to drug resistance.
